AccountId.description: Unique identifier of the account (for example `Customer`) the item belongs to.

OrderId.description: Unique identifier of the order (or `Reservation` which is a special type of order) the item belongs to.

BillId.description: Unique identifier of the `Bill` the item is assigned to.

AccountingCategoryId.description: Unique identifier of the `AccountingCategory` the item belongs to.

UnitCount.description: Unit count of item, i.e. the number of sub-items or units, if applicable.

UnitAmount.title: Amount
UnitAmount.description: Unit amount of item, i.e. the amount of each individual sub-item or unit, if applicable.

Amount.title: Extended amount
Amount.description: Amount of item; note a negative amount represents a rebate or payment.

OriginalAmount.title: Extended amount
OriginalAmount.description: Amount of item; note a negative amount represents a rebate or payment. Contains the earliest known value in conversion chain.

CreatorProfileId.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the item.

UpdaterProfileId.description: Unique identifier of the user who updated the item.

CreatedUtc.description: Creation date and time of the item in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

UpdatedUtc.description: Last update date and time of the item in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

ConsumedUtc.description: Date and time of the item consumption in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

CanceledUtc.description: Cancellation date and time of the item in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

ClosedUtc.description: Date and time of the item bill closure in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

StartUtc.description: Start date and time of the item in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

Data.title: Order item data

Value.description: Based on order item discriminator or `null` for types without any additional data.

Data.description: Additional data specific to particular order item.
